goal: Implement the verified v1 system corrections in reviewable PR units, with parallel independent lanes and explicit contract decisions before architectural changes.
architecture: Reuse the native dependency graph, release-operation DAG, committed release roster and provider-observed in-memory recovery. Separate canonical distribution references, release ownership, version authority and required output/effect completion; native tools/CI retain build and authentication responsibility.
tech_stack: Safe Rust; MIT callisto-model and FSL engine/surface crates
Cargo, npm/pnpm, Python build/Maturin and Twine
System git, gh, curl and GitHub Actions

tasks.title: Restore release-PR producer/consumer compatibility
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-ENV. Baseline: verify reads ReleasePrDecisionWireV2 directly while decide emits flattened ReleasePrDecideReport through emit_report.

At the CLI input boundary, accept a strict unwrapped decision or the same payload with only the known command/dryRun report metadata. Check metadata types and command when supplied; continue passing the extracted strict wire through ReleasePrDecisionV2::from_wire and verify_snapshot. Do not remove deny_unknown_fields from domain types or strip JSON in the action script.

Extend the real-binary contract test for create, update and noop: feed decide output unchanged to verify as inline JSON, a file and stdin. Assert malformed JSON, unknown payload fields, malformed metadata, unsupported versions, wrong repositories and changed snapshots still fail with their typed diagnostics.

Cover the action's own update transition: after exact ref read-back, final verification supplies --applied-head and permits only the original selected PR's head to become that SHA. Validate original update consistency through the shared derivation; retain exact snapshot equality for every other field, pre-move checks and create/noop. Add model, real-binary and shell action negatives for wrong/missing heads and unrelated changes; no decision rewriting in jq.

Run rtk proxy bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test release_pr_commit_plan_tests. The shell suite builds its own binary; do not run a second Cargo process concurrently.

Update affected current criteria/docs and add a callisto-cli patch changeset. The implementation ends at verified local evidence; bot refresh, remote PR operations and self-publication require separate authorization.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): verify generated release-pr decisions

tasks.title: Honor explicit installer versions and source ownership
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-INSTALL. Baseline: install-callisto.sh lines 142 onward use a Cargo.toml substring before the explicit source branch.

Make explicit source=local the authoritative request to build checkout source; auto honors requested release/action-ref pins. If auto-source detection is retained for an existing documented use, validate actual workspace ownership rather than text occurrence, and never let it override an explicit version. Inspect both setup-callisto and callisto-action input wiring.

Add isolated fake-tool tests for a consumer mentioning callisto-cli, an explicit pin in a genuine Callisto checkout, source=local with and without owned source, action-ref defaults and pinned crates.io fallback. Preserve require/fallback/skip attestation behavior.

Run rtk proxy bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh, rtk proxy bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_crates_io_fallback.sh and rtk proxy bash .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_download_extraction_format.sh. Expect requested versions to remain authoritative and invalid local source to fail before arbitrary compilation.
Update operator docs, current contract and a user-visible patch changeset; no download or installation into the user's machine outside isolated fixtures.
tasks.commit_message: fix(setup): validate local source before bypassing version pins

tasks.title: Align schemas with actual report and durable wire shapes
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-SCHEMA. Baseline: Version/PackageId/ReleasePackageId custom serde representations diverge from derived JsonSchema; schema_guard_test checks mostly top-level sets.

Use explicit string-shaped JsonSchema implementations or schema proxy annotations for custom wire leaves, including VersionReq and digest/ID wrappers discovered by the serializer inventory. Preserve existing actual serialization, not the accidental storage-object schema.

Add a dev-only full JSON Schema validator compatible with the emitted schema dialect; validate nested real reports and durable documents, not only a hand-written expected-property list. Keep the validator out of shipped crates.

Cover every SchemaTarget currently exposed, distinguishing payload schemas from CLI envelopes; assert complete status/version/snapshot/pre and release receipt examples pass and invalid nested wire types fail. Native identity/version semantics remain domain-validation tests, not a new universal schema parser. Add decide-to-verify report validation without weakening T01 payload checks.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test schema_guard_test sequentially. Update the CLI schema contract and the per-topic patch changeset; schema repair does not authorize a wire-shape change.
tasks.commit_message: fix(schema): describe serialized report values

tasks.title: Decode durable versions with distribution context
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-PYDEC. Baseline: ReleaseDecisionV1Wire deserializes ReleaseDecisionEntry.target_version through generic Version's SemVer-first guess.

Decode a wire version using its enclosing canonical distribution ecosystem, then validate/canonicalize the domain entry and digest. Apply the same contextual rule to nested reasons, intents, evidence and receipts that carry a distribution; do not silently coerce unsupported grammars or change readable decision versions.

Audit every custom Version decoder and semantic digest path in the MIT model; migrate actual contextual consumers together or record why a context-free leaf is unaffected. Keep native stable strings unchanged on the wire.

Add genuine Python stable emit-decision -> commit -> release plan -> execute/rerun cases alongside Cargo/npm prereleases. Retain schema 1/2, unsupported-schema, digest-tamper and cross-ecosystem mismatch negatives.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model followed by rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test durable_release_e2e_tests. Expect valid Python stable decisions accepted and forged roster/digest content refused.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): preserve native historical version authority

tasks.title: Resolve prerelease baselines using workspace ownership
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-PYPRE. Baseline: parse_pre_json tries SemVer before PEP 440 for every initialVersions string.

Keep the changesets-compatible file format; resolve each baseline key to its owner and parse its raw version in that owner's native grammar before using it. Reuse T03 contextual parsing; preserve #168's historical bare-key attribution and E245 on non-unique ownership.

Exercise stable Python pre enter -> repeated version -> exit, SemVer siblings, qualified/unqualified historical keys, malformed values, custom changesets directory and mixed native grammars. Check emitted native versions and unchanged unrelated baselines.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test pre_mode_tests. Add the regression before changing the decoder; do not require a new persisted pre-state schema without an explicit migration decision.
tasks.commit_message: fix(pre): preserve native baseline grammar

tasks.title: Unify manifest-local dependency names across version paths
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-CASCADE. Baseline: manifest_ecosystem prefers edge.from's display prefix over edge.from_manifest; the shared helper feeds cascade, co-release floor and snapshot.

Determine the native ecosystem from the declaration's actual manifest, not owner/display ID. Preserve declared dependency key/alias separately from resolved native distribution identity where current DepEdge loses it; use IdentityIndex.native_name only for the correct native ecosystem.

Preserve a dependency's declared key and resolved native target at extraction, including Cargo package aliases and inherited aliases; walk must resolve the native target while rewrites retain the declared key. Migrate all DependencyEntry/DepEdge producers and constructors, including Cargo/npm/Python editors and the shared graph fixture, in the same compiling change.
Migrate every helper call site in cascade, floor and snapshot in one change. Preserve inherited Cargo root routing and Python extras/markers/native spelling through their existing editors.

Add promoted Cargo/npm owners with different native names, a renamed Cargo dependency, dependency-only and inherited writes, peer/optional/dev behavior and a snapshot case. Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test identity_promotion_tests and --test native_resolution_e2e_tests sequentially.
Expect correct native declaration keys in all three paths and no unrelated manifest edits. Update criteria and a user-visible changeset together.
tasks.commit_message: fix(version): retain native dependency semantics across manifests

tasks.title: Verify inherited version sources and normalized Git paths
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-INHERITED, SYS-ROOT. Baseline: read_identity exposes Literal/InheritedFromWorkspace, but the two manifest_version_at readers accept only Literal and member-path diffs; ./CHANGELOG.md differs from Git's path.

Share a pure effective historical version-source resolution path over supplied Git blobs and Cargo workspace inheritance, reused by release-commit verification and partial-run detection. Use the authority's actual root path for diff checks and preserve the claimed committed roster instead of recomputing selection.
Normalize workspace-relative paths once before Git blob/diff lookup; cover root '.', member manifests, workspace roots and configured changelog locations without normalizing outside the repository.

Add inherited-version emit/commit/plan, root-package changelog, member version unchanged but authority changed, unclaimed owner changes and malicious path tests. Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-manifests --test cargo_tests, then the durable_release_e2e_tests, partial_run_tests and single_package_root_tests CLI suites sequentially.
Expect genuine authoritative changes accepted, tampered/unclaimed changes refused with existing typed diagnostics and partial-run protection preserved.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): verify effective historical version sources

tasks.title: Preserve pnpm workspace protocol semantics
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-PNPM. Baseline: parse_npm_spec_str discards workspace suffixes and DepSpec::Workspace renders workspace:*; coverage assumes all workspace references cover.

Extend the existing dependency-spec representation to retain raw workspace text plus the semantics needed for wildcard, caret/tilde shorthand, explicit range, alias and relative-path references. Resolve native targets without replacing an alias key with the target's name.

Define coverage and safe rewriting for each admitted form with pnpm's pack transformations. Keep catalogs and unsupported opaque/direct URL inputs explicitly diagnosed or documented; do not invent catalog editing as a requirement.

Add parser/render/coverage unit tests and native pnpm pack plus frozen install fixtures after version and snapshot. Test scoped aliases, an out-of-range explicit workspace constraint, peer/optional/private packages and unchanged catalogs.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-manifests and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test native_resolution_e2e_tests sequentially. Report missing pnpm as a coverage gap, not a passing native test.
tasks.commit_message: fix(pnpm): retain workspace reference semantics

tasks.title: Refresh locks from all actual native write targets
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-LOCK. Baseline: active_ecosystems chooses one ecosystem for each bump and ignores regular dependency-only rewrite targets.

Collect ecosystems from every actual VersionWriteTarget/DepWriteTarget, plus platform and optional-dependency writes. Use the same set for refresh and staging; retain lockfile-specific command selection, no-refresh behavior and transient snapshot staging rules.

Test a promoted/bare dual Cargo/npm owner, Python alongside Cargo, inherited root rewrites, dependency-only writes, multiple npm-family locks and unrelated lockfile preservation. Include a nonzero refresh command and assert E208 stops application.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test native_resolution_e2e_tests. Inspect actual native locked installs for the dual-manifest fixture; a fake command invocation is not sufficient native evidence.
tasks.commit_message: fix(version): refresh every affected native lockfile

tasks.title: Make interrupted versioning diagnosable without losing inputs
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-VERSION-RECOVERY. Baseline: apply deletes consumed changesets before fallible lock refresh/staging; check_partial_run misses an untracked consumed input.

Move irreversible input consumption after fallible native refresh and retain usable input evidence through staging/finalization. Strengthen check_partial_run using T03-HISTORY effective sources so tracked/untracked inputs, root/dependency-only writes and staged/unstaged partial changes cannot silently produce a second bump or false success. Permit active prerelease reruns and pending prerelease-to-stable finalization, but reject already-written stable versions on an exit retry; compare staged inherited Cargo versions against the effective workspace-root version.

Keep derive-before-write and decision emission after successful apply. Define late decision-write/staging failure as actionable refusal with retained release changes, not guaranteed automatic replay of an unavailable in-memory plan. Do not add a journal, new recovery command or rollback.

Inject failures after manifest/changelog writes, during refresh, deletion/staging and decision emission, including an untracked changeset. A fresh command must safely complete an authorized unchanged plan where possible or refuse with specific recovery guidance; it must not lose the remaining input, silently skip work or double-bump.

Inspect the init/release/version dry-run entry permits as shared capability siblings; snapshot transient semantics remain distinct from dry-run. Preserve ordinary user edits and test unchanged bytes/index plus zero external effect calls.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test partial_run_tests, --test durable_release_e2e_tests and --test dry_run_invariant_tests sequentially. Update successful deletion ordering and diagnostics in the spec in the implementation PR.
tasks.commit_message: fix(version): preserve recovery inputs across apply failures

tasks.title: Inventory Cargo binaries and reject unsupported artifact generation
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-BINS, SYS-NONCARGO. Baseline: CargoToml::bin_names returns the first explicit bin or src/main; init accepts npm/Python product slots but generated builders only handle Cargo.

Implement the admitted Cargo binary inventory, including src/bin/name.rs, src/bin/name/main.rs, multiple explicit bins, autobins=false and duplicate explicit/automatic targets. Respect native declared names/paths; do not build a general Cargo target compiler.

Validate artifact-builder support before init writes config/workflow. Reject unsupported npm-bin/Python-script product artifacts with a typed diagnostic; keep registry-only npm/Python releases supported and no-workflow/manual paths accurately documented.

Exercise --dry-run and init no-write failure cases, library-only packages, multiple bins and supported Cargo product selection. Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-manifests --test cargo_tests, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test cli_tests sequentially.
Keep this PR independent of future owner/file-set formats; integrate after T03-HISTORY if both touch cargo.rs.
tasks.commit_message: fix(init): validate supported binary artifact builders

tasks.title: Configure native npm and Twine authentication in generated execution
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-AUTH. Baseline: generated NPM_TOKEN/PYPI_TOKEN names alone do not configure npm's registry auth or Twine username/password.

Inspect the shared action release entry and generated simple/matrix execution path; configure scoped native npm auth and TWINE_USERNAME/TWINE_PASSWORD only at the publishing boundary. Never put tokens into intents, config, plan/build jobs or logged command arguments.

Retain native-tool ownership of authentication, existing npm provenance behavior and this repo's no-Environment/no-reviewer policy. Missing/rejected credentials remain redacted native failures, not a new credential preflight.

Add fresh-home fake-tool assertions and generated workflow checks for Cargo-only, npm, Bun and Python shapes; scope registry auth to the native publisher invocation, keep package-manager lifecycle behavior under package-owner control, and remove registry credentials from the Python build subprocess, plan/build jobs, logs and persisted files.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, rtk proxy bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_contract.sh and rtk proxy bash .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-policy.sh sequentially. Add a user-visible patch changeset.
tasks.commit_message: fix(workflow): configure native publish authentication

tasks.title: Settle scoped model and compatibility contracts before architectural code
steps: Read the decision matrix in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md and obtain owner confirmation only for material choices, not routine implementation details. Existing-contract fixes do not wait for this task.

Implement canonical slash-qualified IDs for all new exact references; reject new bare/colon aliases and resolve existing records only through explicit ownership migration. Settle new default tags and legacy history rules. Keep directory locator distinct from native output identity; do not rename remote tags or infer a genuine source move.
Fix admitted Maturin dynamic/static authority cases and native mapping errors; choose draft/public-announcement timing under the agreed registry-before-announcement policy.

Fix required registry file-set authority before model changes: plan declarations versus build-time filenames/digests, binding to the immutable intent/envelope and per-file versus aggregate partial-operation proof. Do not append operations or change the sealed intent after build.

Choose public Python support and explicit behavior for distinct read/upload routes; authenticated/HTML-only indexes and mutable npm channels remain optional owner decisions. Document that native lifecycle hooks and their effects remain package-owner-controlled and outside Callisto's operation graph.

Record testable cases and exact versioned wire migrations in the proposed architecture/ADR and per-PR packets. Author and approve matching area-spec amendments on implementation branches; current main specs must not assert unshipped behavior. Bind any formal execution handoff to raw approved spec hashes.

Inspect every shared-interface implementer named in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md before passing the design boundary. Unresolved choices pause only dependent architectural tasks; do not mark this portfolio plan as a fully gated Smith handoff.
tasks.commit_message: docs(architecture): settle scoped release ownership contracts

tasks.title: Canonicalize new references through one owner-aware resolver
steps: Baseline: IdentityIndex.resolve_id correctly resolves native names in aggregation, but status pending and diagnostics use PackageId::resolve_unique; new identifiers still depend on sibling collisions.

Implement D01's canonical-reference/migration contract at one shared owner-aware resolver, including native name normalization and actionable legacy ambiguity errors. Emit canonical exact references for add/init/reports/groups/config without conflating different outputs with release owners.

Migrate all selector consumers, both status helpers, package/group rules, changesets, pre-state and CLI selection together. Keep glob matching as an explicitly separate pattern language, not an exact-ID parser.
Align GroupTable::from_groups conflict validation with resolve so no alternate construction path silently bypasses the group invariant; add the sibling constructor regression in config/group tests.

Add paired status/version/matrix/release-selector tests for non-primary native names, unrelated ecosystem-qualified names, scoped npm names, normalized Python names, duplicate native distribution IDs, rejected new bare/colon aliases, migrated historical records and deterministic report ordering. Cover product-package and artifact package selectors alongside groups, package rules and changesets; retain glob patterns as a separate language.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test identity_promotion_tests plus --test status_check_tests sequentially. Update current specs and migration docs with the behavior; retain historical tag readers for T06-HISTORY.
tasks.commit_message: refactor(identity)!: use canonical distribution references

tasks.title: Resolve historic ownership from full native manifest evidence
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-OWNER, SYS-DEMOTION. Baseline: sole_owner_at tests a current first-manifest path; demotion drops newly qualified history.

Share historical ownership resolution between tag selection and pre-state attribution using historical native names and the full admitted manifest roster at the relevant commit. Preserve a source owner's correct bare and qualified history after sibling addition/removal or primary-manifest changes.

Apply D01's explicit rename/move support boundary; refuse uncertain transfer with an actionable error rather than assigning another owner's tag. Do not rename existing tags or require an opaque identity ledger.

Test promotion/demotion, sibling rename, Cargo manifest added to an npm-first directory, changed native names, ambiguous old records, conflicting legacy and canonical pre-state keys, old prerelease keys and custom templates; verify last-release monotonicity and no cross-owner adoption without silently discarding a baseline.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test identity_promotion_tests sequentially. Preserve lazy/cached Git discovery and update docs/specs/ADR status only with the implementation.
tasks.commit_message: fix(identity): preserve owned historical release records

tasks.title: Represent supported native version authority and distribution outputs
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-MATURIN. Baseline: Package::version_grammar rejects admitted Cargo/Python grammar mixing; ManifestIdentity.VersionSource describes only literal/inherited Cargo.

Implement D01's bounded source-authority representation and per-distribution native versions using the existing package/manifest types where possible. Keep MIT model semantics independent of FSL parsing; migrate CargoToml, PackageJson and PyprojectToml together if their shared Manifest contract changes.

Support the agreed co-located Maturin Cargo-owned dynamic version, including inherited Cargo authority, without inserting project.version. Preserve metadata precedence and use only the admitted SemVer-to-PEP-440 mapping; unsupported cases fail before mutation.

Migrate live base versions, bump/apply/snapshot, pre-state, historical verification and native dependency comparisons to the selected authority/distribution representation; do not partially support discovery while release planning still assumes one grammar.

Add the new co-located CLI fixture for static/dynamic decisions, different native names, inherited authority, prerelease/snapshot mapping and unsupported backend/mapping diagnostics. Compare actual built wheel/sdist metadata and a clean consumer install against the planned Python version.

Run scoped model/manifests/graph suites sequentially, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test maturin_version_authority_tests and --test native_resolution_e2e_tests with Python/Maturin prerequisites; record unavailable native build evidence. Go/NuGet remain design examples, not adapters.
tasks.commit_message: refactor(model): represent native distribution version authority

tasks.title: Deduplicate shared physical effects and enforce publication barriers
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-BARRIER. Baseline: ReleaseOperationId roles are distribution-owned; derive_release_inputs independently emits shared tag/forge effects and package dependencies order all owner outputs.

Implement D01's single-owner physical effects and deterministic operation IDs; one tag/draft/upload/publication may be referenced by several distributions but executed once. Reject contradictory tag target/destination/owner declarations before any effect.

Project native dependency publication prerequisites from the relevant manifest/distribution, not every output of the source node. Gate current supported registry ecosystems' shared tag/publication on all required selected native publishes; retain platform-before-owner and artifact-before-publication prerequisites.

Migrate intent validation/digests, preparation, production ValidatedReleaseIntent, SimWorld, provider dispatch, receipt evidence and schema guard tests as one compilation boundary. Do not add a scheduler or persisted execution state.

Check literal-false ApplyPermit construction at release/init entry points against dry-run capability boundaries and retain redacted native stderr for indeterminate failures. Fix a reachable bypass or lost safe diagnostic in this batch; explicitly track a sibling outside the owned boundary.

Add dual Cargo/npm permutations, failure of either registry, shared product assets, selected/unselected native dependencies, dev/non-dev cycles and duplicate/conflicting effects. Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test durable_release_e2e_tests sequentially.

Verify deterministic DAG order and no public announcement before required publications; check Go's hypothetical tag-as-publication scenario without a Go provider. Version the wire if D01 changes identity/proof shape and keep old-reader policy explicit.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): complete shared effects across retries

tasks.title: Observe tagged candidates before declaring a local release complete
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-RETRY. Baseline: derive_unreleased_decision skips locally tagged versions before provider observation; version_is_tagged is a selection shortcut, not completion evidence.

Replace tag-only exclusion with D01's bounded candidate/completion contract. Already-tagged current versions are checked for remaining required effects; fully complete releases perform no writes. Preserve expected-commit trust and exact committed CI rosters; do not broaden release authority to inferred/manual commits.

Keep original immutable artifacts/intent where available. Specify safe refusal for a changed source or unavailable original bytes; never rebuild and replace published version bytes as implicit recovery. Address explicit --package semantics and update REL-CMD-01/08 with implementation.

Fault after local tag, push, draft, upload and public publication; retry the real CLI and assert only missing operations run, remote conflicts block, unrelated old versions are not rereleased and a receipt appears only on complete success.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test release_command_e2e_tests and --test durable_release_e2e_tests. The generated simple action path is part of the test scope, not only retained-intent CI.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): finish remaining effects for tagged versions

tasks.title: Verify and resume the required Python registry file set
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-PYFILES. Baseline: one non-yanked matching file is Exact; python build creates wheel and sdist, and Twine publishes a broad dist glob.

Implement D01's required-file authority/proof contract across plan declarations, trusted build inventory, envelope binding and registry evidence. Exact requires every declared filename/digest; never mutate a sealed intent after build or guess all possible platform wheels.

Migrate CLI artifact-manifest production and release execute's registry-only artifact-input checks/envelope creation, plus local Python build preparation, to the approved required-output contract. Do not invent dummy GitHub slots merely to pass a registry build inventory; mint the envelope only after validating its actual trusted output manifest.

Publish only the intended retained files, resuming missing files after a partial upload without resubmitting completed/conflicting ones. Ensure a partial set cannot mint a false whole-operation Absent/Exact proof; migrate production providers and simulator with any new proof/observation shape.

Cover extra stale dist files, one of two uploads completed, conflicting same filename/digest, mixed yanked files, unobservable/index-lag responses and altered artifact manifests. Do not treat yanking as permission to overwrite.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test pypi_partial_upload_tests, followed by --test release_real_registry_e2e_tests with prerequisites. Inject failure after the first actual file upload and validate recovery through production binding/observation, not argv alone.

Review Cargo/npm/platform evidence as siblings; preserve their existing whole-version behavior unless the approved contract genuinely reaches them. No universal checksum or mutable npm-channel gate is added.
tasks.commit_message: fix(pypi): verify and resume required distribution files

tasks.title: Separate trusted Python index reads from uploads
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-PYROUTES. Baseline: PreparedRegistryBinding.endpoint serves both index reads and Twine uploads.

Implement D01's explicit credential-free read/upload routing and include both effective destinations in binding identity/staleness checks. Preserve default public PyPI/TestPyPI routing and reject credentialed/unsafe overrides before effects.

If private authenticated/HTML-only observation is not approved, fail unsupported configurations clearly before upload and document the boundary. Do not assume Twine auth is curl auth, embed credentials in URLs or add a generic HTTP credential client.
Test different loopback read/upload routes, normalization, approved overrides, changed read or upload endpoint, cross-ecosystem kind mismatch, HTML/private boundaries and credential redaction.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph, then rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test release_plan_pypi_default_registry_test and --test release_real_registry_e2e_tests sequentially. Integration follows T09 to avoid concurrent registry.rs writers.
tasks.commit_message: fix(pypi): separate observation and upload destinations

tasks.title: Build and place only intent-selected supported outputs
steps: Finding coverage: SYS-NAPI. Baseline: generated matrix and placement select all workspace napi targets instead of the verified release intent.

Derive build and placement rosters from immutable intent-selected owners/distributions/artifact declarations, retaining canonical directory and target associations. An unrelated addon must not be built or placed for a Cargo-only release.

Use a shared selected-output projection rather than independent jq/name heuristics in build and placement. Keep public matrix inventory behavior separate from release filtering, and reuse T10-BINS early unsupported-shape validation.

Test Cargo-only beside unrelated napi, one of two addons selected, shared product artifacts, complete required platform selection, empty build roster and tampered/unknown build output. Secret access and no-Environment policy stay unchanged.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph --test matrix_tests, scoped graph unit tests, rtk proxy bash .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh and rtk proxy bash .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-policy.sh sequentially; lint generated simple/matrix workflows with available project-native tools.
Update current CLI/matrix contracts and operator docs; generated Maturin CI remains explicitly unsupported unless separately approved and implemented.
tasks.commit_message: fix(init): generate authoritative supported release workflows

tasks.title: Verify production native workflows and boundary recovery
steps: Run the fixture/evidence matrix in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md with actual native packing/building and representative clean consumer installs. Retain existing local npm/Cargo/PyPI tests and distinguish argv-only, production-provider, simulator and hosted coverage.

Exercise production registry binding/readback for local Cargo/PyPI servers and the new partial Python upload fixture; record each prerequisite skip explicitly. Deterministic faults must cover every changed apply/effect boundary, with missing work converging using original inputs.

Run rtk proxy just ci, plus the relevant shell/workflow policy/contract suites not actually included by just ci. Consider live provider-contract/fixture refresh only with network authority; never recapture fixtures or upload a version as an incidental test.

Record source/branch revisions, exact commands, prerequisite versions, pass/fail/skip counts and remaining findings in V1-VERIFICATION.md. A named test or passing simulator does not establish production coverage.
Correct the receipt run_attempt comment and policy-test message to match attempt-scoped artifact names; do not add an approval gate or change the release workflow's authorization.

Reconcile shipped specs/docs and findings as each PR lands; delete completed implementation plans only after all work they cover ships, retaining owner decisions and measured evidence in the appropriate durable docs.
tasks.commit_message: test(release): exercise native publication and recovery workflows

tasks.title: Measure supported first-release onboarding
steps: Create isolated fresh Cargo, npm/pnpm and supported Python repos and follow documented init/add/commit/version/commit/release steps. Record prerequisites, credential/commit setup and failures, not only successful CLI command duration.

Measure against the owner's existing under-ten-minute goal using local registry targets for repeatability and a separately authorized hosted self-release/publication for real service evidence. Do not claim local tests prove hosted credential/index behavior.

Verify representative package installation, npm native addon load, Python wheel metadata/import and Cargo locked resolution. Maturin local/native support and unsupported generated CI must remain distinguishable.

Use measured failures to improve only in-scope onboarding/docs; report blocker requiring owner choice instead of hiding setup time or publishing without approval. Run documentation/link checks and relevant CLI regressions after doc/example changes.

Close the v1 evidence review only when applicable owner requirements are demonstrated, or report the exact unmet requirement. No arbitrary Go/NuGet gate, new hosted publication or support promise is authorized by this task.
tasks.commit_message: docs(dx): record measured first-release onboarding

batches.title: Immediate release-PR and independent installer fixes
Native dependency producers, protocol semantics and locks
Wire context, pre-state and historical verification
Canonical identity, history and native authority
Shared effects, retry and registry completion

reasoning: Execution portfolio authorized for planning on 2026-09-26; baseline main 8ef9aa5a4 with the existing documentation reconciliation preserved. See docs/projects/V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md for governing-source hashes, PR lanes, concurrency/file-ownership constraints, plugin/model routing, decision checkpoints and explicit roadmap dispositions. Coverage gap: this spans five current-behavior specs and proposed future architecture; there is no single approved persisted delta spec. linked_spec/spec_file_path/spec_hash are intentionally absent rather than inventing a gated Smith handoff. covers_criteria identifies affected current contracts; testable per-PR behavior and any spec amendments must be approved and hash-bound before executing gated architectural packets. Current-contract repair packets may start independently after baseline verification and implementation authorization. D01 blocks only new identity/authority/effect/file-set policy, not existing bugs. No remote PR creation, commits, pushes, branch/worktree creation or publication is authorized by this plan alone. Existing roadmap decisions not implemented here remain explicitly open, not implicit v1 gates.
